content: Loi le utuutu i mena weya ghalɨŋae gharautu

Giya Loi Memevoroniye i woraŋgiya vatomweke iyake e ghino. E tɨne ya thuwe i vakatha bibita lemoyo moli, mbaŋaniye vara rakakaiwo amba thɨ tenɨ eŋge wit kiŋ kaiwae. Na tembe e mbaŋaniyeva weiwo togha amba thɨ yovoro eŋge.

E lo thuweko ya thuwe bibitako thɨ ghanɨvaoŋgiya nanako wolaghɨye, amba yaŋa, “Giya Loi Memevoroniye, u numotenɨŋgi len gharɨgharɨ. Ne ŋgoroŋga na mbe e yawayawalinji? (E maran) thiye nanasiye moliŋgi na thɨ njavovo.”
Amba Giya Loi i vɨva le renuwaŋa na iŋa, “Budakai mo thuwena mane i yomara ŋgoreiye.”

Giya Loi Memevoroniye tembe i woraŋgiyava vatomwe regha e ghino. E tɨne ya thuwe i vakatha varaeko dayaghawa i vurɨgheghe moli na i giya vuyowo weŋgiya gharɨgharɨko. Dayaghako i vakatha njighɨ na mbwa e yambaneke raberabe i mame na i vakatha thelauko ŋgoreiya vugha.
Amba ya dagewe yaŋa, “Meiye Giya Loi. Ne ŋgoroŋga na len gharɨgharɨ mbe e yawayawalinji? (E maran) thiye nanasiye moliŋgi na thɨ njavovo.”
Giya Loi Memevoroniye i vɨva le renuwaŋa na iŋa, “Budakai mo thuwe mane i yomara ŋgoreiye.”

Giya Loi Memevoroniye mbowo i woraŋgiyava vatomwe regha e ghino. E tɨne ya thuwe i ndeghathɨ e dumodumo ghadidiye va thɨ vatad, thɨ vakaiwoŋa rumwaru gha gherughɨrughɨ, na va i ndethɨna rumwaru gha gherughɨrughɨ e nɨmae.

I vaitoŋgo iŋa, “Emos, u thuwe budakai?” Ya gonjoghawe, yaŋa, “Rumwaru gha gherughɨrughɨ.” Amba iŋa, “Ya vakaiwoŋa rumwaru gha gherughɨrughɨ na i woraŋgiya lo gharɨgharɨ ŋgoranjiya dumodumo ma thɨ mboromboro. Mane tembe ya vɨvɨva le renuwaŋa iya nuwaŋguiya ya lithɨko weŋgi.
“The valɨvaŋga Aisake orumburumbuye thɨ kururuwe ne ya mukuwo. The valɨvaŋga thɨ boboma Isirel e tɨne ne ya vakowana ne ya gaithɨ na ya kivwala Kiŋ Jerobowam.”

Amba Amajaiya, iye Betel gha ravowovowo i variye toto weya Jerobowam, iye Isirel gha kiŋ, iŋa, “Emos i von thuwole ghan gharɨgharɨna e tɨnenji. Le utuutuna mane gharɨgharɨ thɨ goriwoyathu, ne i mukuwo vanautumana.

content.text: ‘Jerobowam ne i mare e gaithɨ tɨne,
na ne thɨ vaŋguŋgi Isirel gharɨgharɨniye na thɨ raka itete
lenji ghamba yakuyaku na vethɨ mebwabwari e vanautuma regha.’”

content: Amba Amajaiya i dagewe Emos, iŋa, “Wo u itete valɨvaŋgake iyake, ghen vavaghare gharathuwe! Wo u njogha Juda na vo utuŋa Giya Loi ghalɨŋae gheko, na thiyena tene thɨ giya ghanɨŋga e ghen.
Thava u utuŋa Giya Loi ghalɨŋae gheke, Betel e tɨneke. Gheke kiŋɨke le ghamba kururu, na vanautumake laghɨye lenji ghamba kururu.”

Emos i gonjogha weya Amajaiya, iŋa, “Ghino ma ghalɨŋae gharautu regha, iya thavala thɨ utuŋa Loi ghalɨŋaeko na thɨ ghana uneko. Ghino sip gharanjimbukiki, na tembe ya njimbukikiva manjemanje idanji fig.
Ko iyemaeŋge Giya Loi mbeghamberegha vara i vaŋgu raŋgiyaŋgo e wo kaiwoko tɨne — ghino sip gharanjimbunjimbu — na i dage e ghino ya wa na va utuŋa ghalɨŋae weŋgi le gharɨgharɨ Isirel.”
“Iya kaiwae wo u vandeŋe Giya Loi ghalɨŋae mbaŋake, moŋa,

content.text: ‘Thava vo utuŋa utuutuna iyana weŋgiya Isirel gharɨgharɨniye,
na thava vo vavaghareŋa weŋgiya wabwi Aisake.’
Kaiwae mo utu ŋgoreiyako, Giya Loi iŋa, ‘Len ŋgamaŋgama ne thɨ mare gaithɨ e tɨne, len ghamba yakuyakuna/vanautumana
ne thɨ kivwalaŋgi e gaithɨ, na len ghamba yakuyakuna ne thɨ tagaviyaviya na thɨ giya weŋgi thavala thɨ kivwalaŋge e gaithɨ,
len wevona ne i vakuneŋa riwae e ghamban na tɨne, na ghen ne thɨ vaŋguŋge na tene vo mare e vanautuma mbe regha.
Mbwana, Isirel gharɨgharɨniye ne thɨ vaŋguŋgi na vethɨ mebwabwari e vanautuma regha.’”
